published.source: DPS report 2026-10-31 (wowsimcli on this request, 20,000 iterations, seed 1, 180 ± 20 s; re-simmed on 2026-10-30 or 2026-10-31)

summary: Keeps Battle Shout up for its party. The raid's Battle Shout is off.
rotation: Start with 0 Rage. Bloodrage and Battle Shout at -3s, then Battle Stance, Charge (15 Rage) and back to Berserker Stance
Sunder Armor as the first GCD. Every warrior does this, and the tanks keep it up after
Recast Battle Shout with 35s left on it (about 142s in, before execute), unless its 3 min lasts the fight

Save Death Wish for the last 33s when that doesn't lose a use. Recklessness goes with the last Death Wish, and the trinket 1 GCD later. In fights with 2 Death Wishes, the first goes at the pull without Recklessness

Blood Fury and Berserking with Death Wish. Elune's Light on cooldown, but never during Recklessness or the 15s before it. Trinket on cooldown, with its last use saved for the last 30s. Mighty Rage Potion at the pull, the second in the last 20s
During execute, Execute comes after Bloodthirst and Whirlwind. Putting it first loses 4.7 DPS on Fury and 22.7 on two-hand Fury
Heroic Strike at 80+ Rage, during execute too
Hamstring as filler at 10+ Rage (it procs Windfury Totem and Flurry)
caveats: Assumed: white hits give Rage by weapon speed, at the level 30 rate even at level 60.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks, so Heroic Strike stops at rank VIII, and the raid's Battle Shout at VI, Strength of Earth at IV and Grace of Air at II.
Assumed: the crit Rage bonus is for white hits only. Heroic Strike can trigger Unbridled Wrath.
Only one +2% crit elixir. A second (Grizzly) would add 15.1 DPS.
Battlegear of Glory 4-piece isn't counted. It would add 10.8 DPS vs Humanoids.
Saving Death Wish for the last 33s adds 13.3 DPS at 180s and 26.2 at 120s. Saving the trinket for the last 30s adds 2.2 at 180s.
Saving the second Mighty Rage Potion for the last 20s adds 10.4 DPS at 180s and 0.0 at 120s.
Rage from taking raid damage (2 hits a minute, about 9 Rage each) is an estimate.
notes: Request from mksettings -spec fury -gear level60_phase1_synthetic_fury -apl level60_fury_battle_shout -talents 30305013002-25053005142010501 -race Orc -duration 180, then the raid's battleShout removed (standards 23: the duty preset's own shout is the only one). Raid buffs, Kings and Might, debuffs, consumes, professions (Engineering, Alchemy) and the Level 60 encounter match ui/warrior/presets.ts.
